descriptions.BRICK_WALL: Providing and constructing approved brick masonry in cement mortar 1:6 (1 cement : 6 coarse sand) including scaffolding, curing, raking joints and finishing complete.
descriptions.AAC_BLOCK_WALL: Providing and constructing AAC block masonry in approved thickness with thin-bed polymer adhesive mortar including scaffolding, curing, bonding and joints complete.
descriptions.GLASS_ALUMINIUM_PARTITION: Providing and fixing powder-coated aluminium framed glass partition with approved toughened float glass, EPDM beading, silicone sealant, hardware and installation complete.
descriptions.GYPSUM_PARTITION: Providing and fixing 75mm thick double-skin gypsum board partition with GI framework, approved glass wool insulation, jointing compound, screws and smooth finish complete.
descriptions.VITRIFIED_TILE_FLOOR: Providing and laying vitrified floor tiles (600x600mm or approved) with polymer-modified adhesive bed, spacers, epoxy grouting, cleaning and finishing complete.
descriptions.RCC_COLUMN: Providing and casting reinforced cement concrete in columns of specified grade including formwork, cover blocks, vibration, curing and finishing complete (reinforcement measured separately).
descriptions.RCC_BEAM: Providing and casting reinforced cement concrete in beams of specified grade including shuttering, propping, cover blocks, compaction and curing complete.
descriptions.RCC_SLAB: Providing and casting reinforced cement concrete in suspended floor/roof slabs of specified grade including centering, shuttering, leveling, vibration and curing complete.
descriptions.CEMENT_PLASTER: Providing and applying 15mm thick cement plaster in 1:4 mortar to internal/external wall surfaces including scaffolding, corner beads, curing and finishing smooth.
descriptions.EMULSION_PAINT: Providing and applying two coats of approved premium acrylic emulsion paint over a coat of primer and two coats of wall putty including surface preparation and finishing.
descriptions.FLUSH_DOOR: Providing and fixing 35mm thick solid core flush door shutter with approved wooden/WPC frame, stainless steel ball bearing hinges, mortise lock and hardware complete.
descriptions.ALUMINIUM_WINDOW: Providing and fixing powder-coated aluminium sliding/casement windows with float glass, EPDM weather stripping, rollers, fasteners and silicone perimeter sealant complete.
